headline: Know what a repair is covered for before the wrench comes out
capabilities: Shows coverage, expirations and pending registrations in one view
Pre-checks repair coverage and pulls full unit records
Validates serials and drafts registrations for review
Drafts extended-coverage offers for units ending soon
outcomes: More extensions sold before coverage ends
why_try: The demo walks a dealer service manager from a coverage overview to a covered repair, an expired unit, a clean registration draft and a short list of extension offers, each answer computed from the same fixed snapshot.

sample_prompts.label: Dealer Service Manager: Coverage overview
sample_prompts.prompt: How does our dealership's warranty coverage look right now?

sample_prompts.label: Dealer Service Manager: Claim pre-check
sample_prompts.prompt: A customer brought in welding station WS-25-4471 with a failed wire feeder. Is the repair covered?

sample_prompts.label: Warranty Administrator: Unit warranty record
sample_prompts.prompt: Pull the full warranty record for tire changer TC-90-3307.

sample_prompts.label: Dealer Sales Staff: Serial check
sample_prompts.prompt: We just sold welding station WS-25-4520. Check the serial before we register it.

sample_prompts.label: Dealer Sales Staff: Registration draft
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare the registration for WS-25-4520, but don't submit anything.

sample_prompts.label: Dealer Sales Staff: Extended-coverage offers
sample_prompts.prompt: Which units should we offer extended coverage to this month?

business_flow: Approved ERP warranty module and product catalog
